description: Source code implementing the top-level interface to a shader compiler, including initialization, resource setup, and various accessor functions for shader compilation and reflection data.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the shader compiler process; called once before other operations.

methods.name: Finalize
methods.description: Cleans up the shader compiler process.

methods.name: InitBuiltInResources
methods.description: Sets default minimum resource limits for shader compilation.

methods.name: ConstructCompiler
methods.description: Creates a new shader compiler object with specified type, shader spec, output, and resources.

methods.name: Destruct
methods.description: Destroys a shader compiler object.

methods.name: GetBuiltInResourcesString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the built-in resources of the compiler.

methods.name: Compile
methods.description: Compiles shader source strings using the specified compiler handle.

methods.name: ClearResults
methods.description: Clears previous compilation results.

methods.name: GetShaderVersion
methods.description: Returns the shader version of the compiled shader.

methods.name: GetShaderOutputType
methods.description: Returns the output type of the shader.

methods.name: GetInfoLog
methods.description: Retrieves the compilation log messages.

methods.name: GetObjectCode
methods.description: Retrieves the compiled object code.

methods.name: GetNameHashingMap
methods.description: Returns the map of name hashings used in the shader.

methods.name: GetUniforms
methods.description: Returns the list of uniform variables.

methods.name: GetInputVaryings
methods.description: Returns the list of input varyings.

methods.name: GetOutputVaryings
methods.description: Returns the list of output varyings.

methods.name: GetVaryings
methods.description: Returns varyings based on shader type.

methods.name: GetAttributes
methods.description: Returns attribute variables.

methods.name: GetOutputVariables
methods.description: Returns output variables.

methods.name: GetInterfaceBlocks
methods.description: Returns interface blocks.

methods.name: GetUniformBlocks
methods.description: Returns uniform blocks.

methods.name: GetShaderStorageBlocks
methods.description: Returns shader storage blocks.

methods.name: GetComputeShaderLocalGroupSize
methods.description: Returns local group size for compute shaders.

methods.name: GetVertexShaderNumViews
methods.description: Returns number of views for vertex shader.

methods.name: GetShaderSharedMemorySize
methods.description: Returns shared memory size for shader.
